content.title: Rivian Stock Soars Following These Announcements At Its Autonomy & AI Day
content.summary: Rivian surged in Friday's stock market to its highest levels since January 2024 following Thursday's "Autonomy & AI Day" where the EV startup announced it has developed an in-house silicon AI chip, while also outlining its next-generation AI platform.  Rivian also reported its new autonomous vehicle platform will include a combination of cameras, radar and LiDAR.  The EV startup held its "Autonomy & AI Day" at noon ET Thursday and CEO RJ Scaringe, speaking from Palo Alto, said in late 2026 its "Generation 3" autonomy platform will use AI, along with 65 megapixel cameras, a radar array with an added front-facing long range LiDAR.
